audit: erun outputs download --dry-run ../../etc/passwd
outputs: downloading <HOME>/.erun/outputs/passwd
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
outputs download script:
  target='<HOME>/.erun/outputs/passwd'
  if [ -d "$target" ]; then
    printf 'dir\n'
    tar czf - --exclude=/dev --exclude=/proc --exclude=/sys -C '<HOME>/.erun/outputs' 'passwd' | base64
  elif [ -f "$target" ]; then
    size=$(stat -c %s "$target" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [ "$size" -gt 104857600 ]; then echo "erun-outputs: file exceeds size limit" >&2; exit 4; fi
    printf 'file\n'
    base64 "$target"
  else
    echo "erun-outputs: not found: $target" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
outputs: would write passwd
